Standard contained InkResponse with circular highlight and explicit InkRipple uses custom rounded clipping. This avoids Material-host clipping and rectangular-layer clipping; no custom animation or splash factory is introduced.

Button/enabled/expanded semantics, label, tap action, Space/Enter activation, busy null callback and busy canRequestFocus=false are preserved explicitly or through standard InkResponse. Existing TextButton defaults supply foreground, overlay and feedback; same labelLarge metrics/style and ambient text scale are used.
